name: RW03-B3 PO and receipt matcher
description: RW03-B3 (RW03 real-world test). Loads the supplier, PO and receipt records into the QA database, fuzzy-matches the supplier name to the master (aliases too), joins invoice lines to PO lines by SKU, checks the agreed price with the ERP price service (SOAP), works out quantity, price and tax variance, converts to EUR at the fixed rates, branches by the tolerances, never matches a PO twice and gives the decision and its reason.

variables.name: base
variables.description: Folder of the real-world tests: data, output and the stand-in server.

variables.name: run_id
variables.description: Run id shared by a main agent and its children; made here when empty.

variables.name: standin
variables.description: Address of the local QA stand-in server (127.0.0.1 only).

variables.name: watch
variables.description: Show message boxes and pause between records so a person can follow the run.

variables.name: pause_seconds
variables.description: Pause after each record when watch is on.

variables.name: fault_profile
variables.description: none, or resilience: the stand-ins inject the five failures of runbook step 09.

variables.name: exceptions
variables.description: Records routed to the exception list.

variables.name: status
variables.description: success when every record was handled (routed exceptions included).

variables.name: result_file
variables.description: CSV file with one row per record.

variables.name: price_tolerance
variables.description: Price variance (per cent) above which the invoice goes to the buyer.

variables.name: evidence_file
variables.description: Evidence rows of this agent (one per record).

args.text: What this agent does: Loads the supplier, PO and receipt records into the QA database, fuzzy-matches the supplier name to the master (aliases too), joins invoice lines to PO lines by SKU, checks the agreed price with the ERP price service (SOAP), works out quantity, price and tax variance, converts to EUR at the fixed rates, branches by the tolerances, never matches a PO twice and gives the decision and its reason. It works through 10 invoice dossiers (the extracted ones) and writes its results to the run's output folder.
